notes.title: Patch 9/22/2019
notes.content:
A few days ago, the game was updated with a patch to fix some issues regarding a puzzle in the second dungeon. I also took the time to add an additional secret area as a result of some feedback during a stream. It's somewhere in the first dungeon. 

That's all really! Nothing big! 

Thanks for playing as usual.

- MirageV
